papers.title: Comprehensive risk assessment of urban flood process based on dynamic weights and lumped impact parameters
papers.abstractEn: Based on the dynamic process of urban flooding under extreme rainfall, this study proposes a comprehensive risk assessment method using dynamic weights and a lumped impact parameter. By physically integrating inundation depth and flow velocity, a comprehensive impact parameter is defined to quantify flood damage to exposed elements. Hydraulic conditions are classified into seven categories according to their damage characteristics, and the analytic hierarchy process is used to assign dynamic weights for each category. Coupled with exposure density and the fuzzy matter-element method, the comprehensive risk of the flood process is evaluated for the southern Jinshui District of Zhengzhou, China. Results show that at 09:00 the total area of high, medium and low comprehensive risk peaked at 27.18% of the study area. Compared with the traditional static-weight method, the dynamic-weight approach identifies high-risk zones more accurately and better matches the actual flood situation, providing a scientific basis for urban flood management and infrastructure planning.
papers.abstractZh: 针对极端暴雨下城市洪涝动态过程, 提出基于动态权重与集总影响参数的综合风险评估方法: 耦合淹没水深与流速定义综合影响参数, 按损害特征分7类赋动态权重, 结合承灾体密度与模糊物元法评估郑州金水区南部风险. 结果表明9:00高风险区峰值占27.18%, 较静态权重更精准, 可为城市防洪规划提供依据.
papers.value: 聚焦极端暴雨下城市洪涝动态风险, 方法可迁移至强降雨城市内涝评估, 对水利备考中城市防洪与风险管控有直接参考价值.

papers.title: Evaluating the effectiveness of four representative land uses in soil and water conservation on a typical rainfed Mediterranean agricultural landscape in La Rioja (Spain)
papers.abstractEn: Mediterranean steep-slope agricultural landscapes are highly vulnerable to soil erosion under climate and land-use change. After the 1992 EU agricultural reform, tilled unseeded fallow land expanded in Spain, altering erosion dynamics, yet comparisons of its hydrological and soil-conservation performance with crops remain limited. This study evaluates the hydro-sedimentary response of unseeded fallow versus three Mediterranean crops (olive, vineyard, barley) on steep slopes in La Rioja, using a flexible simulation model (SMIWE) to determine suitable land use under extreme rainfall. Surface water depth, sediment flux and erosion rates are compared. Fallow shows the lowest surface water depth (0.001 m) but the highest sediment flux (0.04 kg m-1 s-1) and erosion rate, 39% higher than vineyards. Among crops, vineyards have the lowest sediment flux and erosion, 13% lower than olive and 2% lower than barley. The findings underscore the erosion vulnerability of fallow land and the importance of crop selection for landscape sustainability.
papers.abstractZh: 以西班牙里奥哈陡坡为例, 采用柔性模型(SMIWE)对比未播种休耕地与橄榄、葡萄园、大麦的水土保持效应. 休耕地地表水深最低但泥沙通量与侵蚀率最高, 较葡萄园高39%; 葡萄园侵蚀最低, 较橄榄低13%. 揭示休耕地侵蚀脆弱性, 凸显作物选择对水土保持的重要性.
papers.value: 直接对比不同土地利用的水土保持效益, 为坡耕地治理与植被措施配置提供定量依据, 是水土保持备考的核心案例.

papers.title: Regenerating rural soil and ecosystems: A 15-year systematic review of emerging methods and technologies
papers.abstractEn: Rural soil and ecosystem degradation threaten global food security, biodiversity and environmental stability. While conventional remediation is costly and context-limited, novel methods have emerged for soil regeneration. This systematic review synthesizes 15 years (2010-2024) of peer-reviewed literature from SCOPUS on emerging regenerative approaches, including bioremediation, agroecological practices, microbial inoculants, biochar and AI- and remote-sensing-integrated monitoring. Bibliometric and thematic analyses map research trends, collaboration networks and conceptual developments, while qualitative synthesis evaluates effectiveness, scalability and ecological relevance across rural settings. Results reveal a sharp rise in interdisciplinary research linking agronomy, soil science, ecology and geospatial science, but persistent barriers to adoption by smallholders and a scarcity of localized adaptive solutions. Unlike prior reviews, this study integrates quantitative bibliometrics with qualitative appraisal of real-world applications, offering region-specific strategies and calling for scalable, technology-integrated frameworks aligned with traditional knowledge.
papers.abstractZh: 系统综述2010-2024年土壤再生技术(生物修复、生物炭、微生物接种、AI与遥感监测等). 文献计量与主题分析显示跨学科研究显著增长, 但小农户采纳障碍与本地化方案匮乏仍突出. 研究融合定量文献计量与实地应用评价, 提出区域化与融合传统知识的修复框架.
papers.value: 系统梳理土壤生态修复前沿技术, 涵盖生物炭与遥感监测, 对理解退化生态系统修复路径与生态修复备考极有帮助.

papers.title: 县-小流域-图斑多层级水土流失治理策略
papers.abstractZh: 以贵州普安县为例, 采用三层迭代图斑识别衔接遥感监测与水土保持率, 获取水土流失图斑并判别宜治理对象; 综合严重程度与宜治程度评价小流域优先度. 图斑识别误差低于1%、判别准确率95.82%; 预计2025-2035年分阶段治理3.44、43.35、46.26 km2, 可达水土保持率目标.
papers.abstractEn: To address the gap between remote-sensing monitoring and precise soil-erosion control, this study takes Pu'an County, a karst area in Guizhou, as a case. A three-layer iterative plot-identification method is used to link remote-sensing products with the current soil and water conservation rate, extracting erosion plots and identifying treatable targets. By integrating erosion severity and treatability at the small-watershed scale, governance priority is quantified and a multi-level strategy at county, small watershed and plot is proposed. Results show that the total erosion area from plot identification has a relative error below 1% against monitoring data, with an overall classification accuracy of 95.82% across intensity grades. Erosion in Pu'an concentrates in cropland, forest and grassland, and watersheds with priority above 0.6 account for 6.31% of the county. Simulated governance areas of 3.44, 43.35 and 46.26 km2 for 2025, 2025-2030 and 2030-2035 are expected to meet staged conservation-rate targets.
papers.value: 提供县-小流域-图斑多层级治理框架与优先度量化方法, 对小流域综合治理规划与流域管理备考有直接的实践参考.

papers.title: 地下坝防治海水入侵的三维数值模拟与混合整数多目标优化
papers.abstractZh: 以山东龙口黄水河库区为例, 建立SEAWAT_V4三维变密度地下水流-盐分运移模型, 与改进NSGA-II耦合, 以最小化抽咸注淡量与减缓入侵为双目标构建混合整数多目标优化. 结果表明坝位与长度显著影响效果, 抽咸注淡形成水力屏障清除坝后咸水, 帕累托前沿提供多元方案.
papers.abstractEn: Coastal aquifers suffer seawater intrusion from over-exploitation of groundwater; subsurface dams block intrusion but trap saline water landward. Under complex hydrogeological conditions the retreat mechanism of trapped saltwater, oversimplified models and single remediation strategies remain unresolved. Taking the Huangshui River reservoir area in Longkou, Shandong, as a case, this study builds a 3D variable-density groundwater flow and salt-transport model based on SEAWAT_V4, and deeply couples it with an improved NSGA-II to construct a mixed-integer multi-objective optimization model with two conflicting goals: minimizing extraction-injection volume and mitigating intrusion. Results show that dam location and length significantly affect control effectiveness; saltwater extraction and freshwater injection form a regional hydraulic barrier that efficiently removes landward saline water and evidently alleviates intrusion. The derived Pareto front provides well-distributed extraction-injection strategies to satisfy diverse management needs.
papers.value: 融合三维地下水数值模拟与多目标优化, 解决地下坝后咸水治理, 对地下水数值模拟与水资源调控备考有较高参考价值.
